do.text: Use a select for five or more options that need not all show at once.

dont.text: Don't hide two options behind a popup: a switch or a radio group shows both in one look.

do.text: Use a [Combobox](/components/combobox) once the list runs past a screenful: people find an option by typing.

dont.text: Don't make people scroll through 120 rows to find one.

do.text: Mark the trigger `aria-invalid` and add a `FieldError` that says how to fix it; screen readers announce it.

dont.text: Don't mark the field red with `aria-invalid` alone: colour by itself tells no one what to do.
